comparison.objective: Seat two IV-set fitments in sequence without twisting or stretching their connecting tube.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed seating and clip insertion while managing a deformable tether.
comparison.success_condition: Both fitments seated in order; tubing remains unstretched and untwisted; hands clear for two seconds.
comparison.reason: This tests deformable-line management and sequential keyed seating, not an aligned rail-to-jig transfer with uninterrupted support for loose rolling elements.
